records.definition: The ratio of oil and dissolved-gas volume at reservoir conditions to the oil volume at standard conditions.
records.definition_ar: نسبة حجم النفط والغاز المذاب عند ظروف المكمن إلى حجم النفط عند الظروف القياسية.
records.engineering_meaning: Bo converts a stock-tank oil volume to its corresponding reservoir volume and depends on pressure, temperature, composition, and the saturation state.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يحوّل Bo حجم النفط في الخزان السطحي إلى حجمه المكافئ داخل المكمن، ويتأثر بالضغط والحرارة والتركيب وحالة التشبع.
records.dimensional_meaning: Reservoir oil volume per stock-tank oil volume; dimensionless ratio with field-volume labels.
records.formula: Bo = reservoir oil volume / stock-tank oil volume
records.usage: Used in material balance, volumetric calculations, reservoir simulation, and conversion between surface and reservoir oil volumes.
records.notes: Bo is commonly greater than 1.0 because reservoir oil may contain dissolved gas.
records.limitations: A numerical Bo value requires a defined fluid state and a validated PVT method; this record is an explanation, not a standalone PVT calculator.
source: SLB Energy Glossary — oil formation volume factor: https://glossary.slb.com/terms/o/oil_formation_volume_factor

Engineering LibreTexts — Volumetric Factors (Bo and Bg): https://eng.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/Chemical_Engineering/Phase_Relations_in_Reservoir_Engineering_(Adewumi)/18%3A_Properties_of_Natural_Gas_and_Condensates_I/18.05%3A_Volumetric_Factors_(Bo_and_Bg)

records.definition: The ratio of gas volume at reservoir conditions to the corresponding gas volume at standard conditions.
records.definition_ar: نسبة حجم الغاز عند ظروف المكمن إلى حجمه المكافئ عند الظروف القياسية.
records.engineering_meaning: Bg accounts for gas expansion or compression between standard and reservoir conditions and is strongly dependent on pressure, temperature, and Z-factor.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يصف Bg تمدد الغاز أو انضغاطه بين الظروف القياسية وظروف المكمن، ويتأثر بقوة بالضغط والحرارة ومعامل الانضغاطية Z.
records.dimensional_meaning: Reservoir gas volume per standard gas volume.
records.formula: Bg = 0.00505 Z (T + 460) / P when the conventional field-unit form is used
records.usage: Used in gas material balance, gas-in-place estimates, reservoir simulation, and surface-to-reservoir volume conversion.
records.notes: The numerical constant belongs to a particular field-unit convention; units must be stated.
records.limitations: A numerical Bg value requires a defined pressure, temperature, and gas property method.
source: Engineering LibreTexts — Volumetric Factors (Bo and Bg): https://eng.libretexts.org/Bookshelves/Chemical_Engineering/Phase_Relations_in_Reservoir_Engineering_(Adewumi)/18%3A_Properties_of_Natural_Gas_and_Condensates_I/18.05%3A_Volumetric_Factors_(Bo_and_Bg)
Craft and Hawkins, Applied Petroleum Reservoir Engineering

records.definition: The volume of reservoir water corresponding to one unit volume of water at standard conditions.
records.definition_ar: حجم الماء عند ظروف المكمن المقابل لوحدة حجم من الماء عند الظروف القياسية.
records.engineering_meaning: Bw is used to convert produced or injected surface-water volumes to reservoir conditions.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يُستخدم Bw لتحويل أحجام الماء المنتجة أو المحقونة على السطح إلى أحجامها عند ظروف المكمن.
records.dimensional_meaning: Reservoir water volume per standard water volume.
records.usage: Used in water material balance, reservoir simulation, and multiphase rate conversion.
records.notes: The value is fluid-state dependent and should not be assumed constant without stating the assumption.
records.limitations: This record does not calculate Bw from salinity, pressure, or temperature.
source: Craft and Hawkins, Applied Petroleum Reservoir Engineering

records.definition: The amount of gas dissolved in oil, expressed per unit volume of stock-tank oil, at a specified fluid state.
records.definition_ar: كمية الغاز المذاب في النفط معبّرًا عنها لكل وحدة حجم من نفط الخزان السطحي عند حالة مائعة محددة.
records.engineering_meaning: Rs describes how much gas remains dissolved in the oil phase and changes with pressure, temperature, composition, and separation conditions.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يصف Rs كمية الغاز التي تبقى مذابة في طور النفط، ويتغير مع الضغط والحرارة والتركيب وظروف الفصل.
records.dimensional_meaning: Standard gas volume per stock-tank oil volume.
records.formula: Above Pb for a conventional black-oil description, Rs is commonly held at Rsi; below Pb it declines as gas evolves.

formula_variables.Rsi: solution gas-oil ratio at initial or saturation state

records.usage: Used with Bo in black-oil PVT, material balance, reservoir simulation, and surface/reservoir rate conversion.
records.notes: Rs is not the same as produced GOR; produced GOR can include free gas.
records.limitations: A numerical Rs value requires a defined PVT state and separator convention.

records.canonical_arabic_name: نسبة الغاز إلى النفط المنتجة التراكمية
records.definition: The cumulative produced gas divided by cumulative produced oil over a defined production period.
records.definition_ar: إجمالي الغاز المنتج تراكميًا مقسومًا على إجمالي النفط المنتج تراكميًا خلال فترة إنتاج محددة.
records.engineering_meaning: Rp is a production-history ratio and should not be confused with solution GOR Rs or a single-period producing GOR.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: Rp نسبة مرتبطة بتاريخ الإنتاج، ولا ينبغي الخلط بينها وبين Rs أو GOR لفترة إنتاج واحدة.
records.dimensional_meaning: Cumulative standard gas volume per cumulative stock-tank oil volume.
records.formula: Rp = cumulative gas produced / cumulative oil produced
records.usage: Used in material-balance interpretation and production-history analysis.
records.notes: The reporting period and standard conditions should be stated.
records.limitations: No numerical value is inferred without production data.
source: Craft and Hawkins, Applied Petroleum Reservoir Engineering

records.definition: The ratio of produced gas volume to produced oil volume under a stated measurement convention.
records.definition_ar: نسبة حجم الغاز المنتج إلى حجم النفط المنتج وفقًا لاصطلاح قياس محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: GOR is a production ratio; its interpretation depends on whether it is instantaneous, cumulative, separator-based, or solution GOR.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: GOR نسبة إنتاجية، ويتوقف تفسيرها على كونها لحظية أو تراكمية أو مبنية على الفاصل أو على الغاز المذاب.
records.formula: GOR = produced gas rate / produced oil rate

formula_variables.produced gas rate: gas rate on the stated basis
formula_variables.produced oil rate: oil rate on the stated basis

records.usage: Used in production surveillance, PVT interpretation, VLP, choke calculations, and facility sizing.
records.notes: SLB defines GOR as the ratio of produced gas to produced oil.
records.limitations: A GOR value without standard-condition and time-basis information can be ambiguous.

records.definition: The ratio of gas volume to total produced liquid volume under a stated measurement convention.
records.definition_ar: نسبة حجم الغاز إلى الحجم الكلي للسائل المنتج وفقًا لاصطلاح قياس محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: GLR differs from GOR when the liquid includes both oil and water; it is also used when describing gas-lift injection relative to liquid rate.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يختلف GLR عن GOR عندما يشمل السائل النفط والماء معًا، ويُستخدم أيضًا لوصف غاز الرفع بالنسبة إلى معدل السائل.
records.dimensional_meaning: Gas volume per total liquid volume.
records.formula: GLR = gas volume / total liquid volume

formula_variables.total liquid volume: oil plus water volume on the stated basis

records.usage: Used in gas-lift descriptions, multiphase-flow calculations, and production reporting.
records.notes: Always state whether injected gas, produced gas, or total gas is intended.
records.limitations: Terminology varies by field and application; ambiguity should be clarified.

records.definition: The pressure at which the first bubble of gas comes out of solution from an oil at a specified temperature and composition.
records.definition_ar: الضغط الذي تظهر عنده أول فقاعة غاز منفصلة من النفط عند درجة حرارة وتركيب محددين.
records.engineering_meaning: Pb separates an undersaturated-oil state from a state where free gas can develop during pressure reduction.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يفصل Pb بين حالة النفط غير المشبع والحالة التي يمكن أن يتكون فيها غاز حر عند انخفاض الضغط.
records.usage: Used to classify PVT regions and select the appropriate black-oil property behavior.
records.notes: Bubble point is fluid-state dependent and is not interchangeable with dew point for gas-condensate systems.
records.limitations: A numerical Pb requires composition or a validated correlation with its input range stated.

records.definition: The pressure at which the first drop of liquid forms from a gas at a specified temperature and composition.
records.definition_ar: الضغط الذي تتكون عنده أول قطرة سائل من الغاز عند درجة حرارة وتركيب محددين.
records.engineering_meaning: Dew-point pressure is central to gas-condensate phase behavior and the onset of retrograde liquid formation.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: ضغط نقطة الندى أساسي لفهم سلوك الغاز المكثف وبدء تكوّن السائل الرجعي.
records.usage: Used in gas-condensate evaluation, facility pressure management, and PVT phase-region descriptions.
records.notes: Dew point and bubble point refer to different phase boundaries.
records.limitations: A numerical dew point requires a defined composition and thermodynamic method.
source: Engineering LibreTexts, phase relations in reservoir engineering

records.definition: A measure of the resistance of oil to flow under specified conditions.
records.definition_ar: مقياس مقاومة النفط للجريان عند ظروف محددة.
records.engineering_meaning: Oil viscosity affects mobility, pressure loss, inflow, and multiphase-flow behavior; it depends on pressure, temperature, and dissolved gas.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تؤثر لزوجة النفط في الحركة وفقد الضغط والجريان الداخل والجريان متعدد الأطوار، وتتأثر بالضغط والحرارة والغاز المذاب.
records.usage: Used in Darcy-flow, IPR, VLP, nodal analysis, and PVT property evaluation.
records.notes: The measurement or correlation range should be stated.
records.limitations: No viscosity value is inferred without fluid state and a validated property method.

records.definition: A measure of the resistance of gas to flow under specified pressure and temperature conditions.
records.definition_ar: مقياس مقاومة الغاز للجريان عند ضغط ودرجة حرارة محددين.
records.engineering_meaning: Gas viscosity contributes to mobility, pressure loss, deliverability, and multiphase-flow calculations.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تدخل لزوجة الغاز في الحركة وفقد الضغط وقابلية الإنتاج وحسابات الجريان متعدد الأطوار.
records.usage: Used in gas-flow, VLP, nodal, gas-lift, and PVT-property calculations.
records.notes: Gas viscosity is state dependent and may require gas gravity and temperature.
records.limitations: No numerical property is calculated by the knowledge layer.

records.definition: A measure of the resistance of water to flow under specified conditions.
records.definition_ar: مقياس مقاومة الماء للجريان عند ظروف محددة.
records.engineering_meaning: Water viscosity affects water mobility, pressure loss, and the relative contribution of the water phase to total flow.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تؤثر لزوجة الماء في حركته وفقد الضغط ومساهمة طور الماء في الجريان الكلي.
records.usage: Used in multiphase mobility and well-performance calculations.
records.notes: Salinity and temperature may be material to the property value.
records.limitations: No water-property correlation is implemented in the knowledge layer.
source: Craft and Hawkins, Applied Petroleum Reservoir Engineering

records.definition: A gravity scale used to express the relative density of petroleum liquids, referenced to water at standard conditions.
records.definition_ar: مقياس يُستخدم للتعبير عن الكثافة النسبية للسوائل البترولية مقارنة بالماء عند الظروف القياسية.
records.engineering_meaning: Higher API gravity generally indicates a lighter petroleum liquid, while lower API gravity indicates a denser liquid.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تشير درجة API الأعلى عمومًا إلى سائل بترولي أخف، بينما تشير الدرجة الأقل إلى سائل أعلى كثافة.
records.si_unit: No SI unit; related to density
records.formula: API = 141.5 / specific gravity at 60°F - 131.5

formula_variables.specific gravity: liquid specific gravity at the stated reference temperature

records.usage: Used in fluid characterization, PVT correlations, classification, and production reporting.
records.notes: Reference temperature and the density basis must be stated.
records.limitations: API gravity alone does not define a complete reservoir-fluid composition.

records.definition: A dimensionless factor that represents deviation of a real gas from ideal-gas behavior.
records.definition_ar: معامل لا بُعدي يعبّر عن انحراف الغاز الحقيقي عن سلوك الغاز المثالي.
records.engineering_meaning: Z enters gas-volume, density, and pressure relationships and varies with pressure, temperature, and gas composition.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يدخل Z في علاقات حجم الغاز وكثافته وضغطه، ويتغير مع الضغط والحرارة وتركيب الغاز.
records.formula: P V = Z n R T
records.usage: Used in gas PVT, gas-in-place calculations, VLP, gas-lift, and flow calculations.
records.notes: Z is not automatically equal to 1 except as an ideal-gas approximation.
records.limitations: A numerical Z requires a defined gas state and a stated correlation or EOS.

records.definition: A measure of fractional volume change per unit pressure change under a stated thermodynamic condition.
records.definition_ar: مقياس للتغير النسبي في الحجم لكل تغير في الضغط عند شرط ترموديناميكي محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Compressibility influences storage, pressure response, material balance, and pressure-transient behavior.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تؤثر الانضغاطية في التخزين واستجابة الضغط وموازنة المادة وسلوك اختبارات الضغط.
records.formula: c = -(1/V) (dV/dP) under the stated condition
records.usage: Used in material balance, transient analysis, and reservoir-storage calculations.
records.notes: Oil, gas, water, and rock compressibilities are different properties.
records.limitations: A numerical value depends on fluid or rock type, state, and derivative convention.

records.definition: The fraction of total rock volume occupied by pore space.
records.definition_ar: النسبة من الحجم الكلي للصخرة التي تشغلها الفراغات المسامية.
records.engineering_meaning: Porosity describes storage capacity, while permeability describes flow capacity; the two properties are related but not interchangeable.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تصف المسامية سعة التخزين، بينما تصف النفاذية سعة الجريان؛ وهما خاصيتان مرتبطتان لكن غير متبادلتين.
records.dimensional_meaning: Pore volume divided by bulk rock volume.
records.formula: φ = pore volume / bulk volume

formula_variables.pore volume: volume of connected and/or total pores according to the definition

records.usage: Used in volumetric in-place calculations, petrophysics, and reservoir characterization.
records.notes: Effective and total porosity are different conventions.
records.limitations: The interpretation depends on measurement method and whether effective or total porosity is intended.

records.definition: A property describing a porous medium’s capacity to transmit fluid under a pressure gradient.
records.definition_ar: خاصية تصف قدرة الوسط المسامي على نقل المائع تحت تأثير تدرج ضغط.
records.engineering_meaning: Permeability controls the ease of flow through the rock and is distinct from porosity, which describes storage space.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تتحكم النفاذية في سهولة الجريان داخل الصخر، وهي مختلفة عن المسامية التي تصف حيز التخزين.
records.formula: Darcy’s law relates flow rate to permeability, viscosity, pressure gradient, and geometry.
records.usage: Used in reservoir deliverability, material balance support, well testing, and flow modeling.
records.notes: Absolute, effective, and relative permeability are different concepts.
records.limitations: The value depends on direction, fluid saturation, scale, and measurement method.

records.canonical_arabic_name: حاصل ضرب النفاذية الأفقية في السمك
records.definition: The product of horizontal permeability and reservoir thickness over the interval of interest.
records.definition_ar: حاصل ضرب النفاذية الأفقية في سمك المكمن ضمن الفترة محل الدراسة.
records.engineering_meaning: kh is an important transmissibility measure in well testing and reservoir-flow interpretation.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يُعد kh مقياسًا مهمًا لقابلية النقل في اختبارات الآبار وتفسير جريان المكمن.
records.formula: kh = k_h × h
records.usage: Used in pressure-transient analysis and transmissibility descriptions.
records.notes: The interval and permeability direction must be stated.
records.limitations: No kh value is inferred without thickness and directional permeability data.
source: Earlougher, Advances in Well Test Analysis

records.definition: Permeability measured or interpreted in the vertical direction of the reservoir.
records.definition_ar: النفاذية المقاسة أو المفسرة في الاتجاه الرأسي للمكمن.
records.engineering_meaning: kv influences vertical communication, coning, crossflow, and layered-reservoir behavior.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تؤثر kv في الاتصال الرأسي والمخروطية والجريان المتبادل وسلوك المكامن الطبقية.
records.formula: Anisotropy is often described through kv/kh, with the convention explicitly stated.

formula_variables.kh: horizontal permeability or kh product depending on context

records.usage: Used in layered-reservoir and vertical-flow interpretation.
records.notes: Do not confuse kv with a kh product.
records.limitations: The value depends on sample scale, layering, fractures, and measurement method.

records.definition: The fraction of pore volume occupied by water.
records.definition_ar: النسبة من الحجم المسامي التي يشغلها الماء.
records.engineering_meaning: Sw determines the remaining pore-volume fractions occupied by oil and gas and affects relative permeability and in-place calculations.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يحدد Sw أجزاء الحجم المسامي التي يشغلها النفط والغاز، ويؤثر في النفاذية النسبية وحسابات الكميات الأصلية.
records.dimensional_meaning: Water-filled pore volume divided by total pore volume.
records.formula: Sw + So + Sg = 1 for a three-phase saturation description
records.usage: Used in volumetric calculations, saturation interpretation, and multiphase-flow models.
records.notes: Saturation values require a defined pore-volume basis.
records.limitations: Residual and irreducible saturation conventions must be stated.

records.definition: The fraction of pore volume occupied by oil.
records.definition_ar: النسبة من الحجم المسامي التي يشغلها النفط.
records.engineering_meaning: So is used with porosity, bulk volume, and Bo in oil-in-place calculations and with relative permeability in flow models.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يُستخدم So مع المسامية والحجم الكلي وBo في حسابات النفط الأصلي ومع النفاذية النسبية في نماذج الجريان.
records.dimensional_meaning: Oil-filled pore volume divided by total pore volume.
records.formula: So = 1 - Sw - Sg
records.usage: Used in volumetric estimates, saturation models, and multiphase-flow calculations.
records.notes: The saturation convention must distinguish mobile and residual oil when relevant.
records.limitations: No saturation is inferred without rock/fluid data.
source: Craft and Hawkins, Applied Petroleum Reservoir Engineering

records.definition: The fraction of pore volume occupied by gas.
records.definition_ar: النسبة من الحجم المسامي التي يشغلها الغاز.
records.engineering_meaning: Sg is important once free gas exists and affects gas relative permeability, mobility, and gas-in-place interpretation.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يصبح Sg مهمًا عند وجود غاز حر، ويؤثر في النفاذية النسبية للغاز وحركته وتفسير الغاز الأصلي.
records.dimensional_meaning: Gas-filled pore volume divided by total pore volume.
records.formula: Sg = 1 - Sw - So
records.usage: Used in gas-condensate and black-oil multiphase-flow descriptions.
records.notes: Free-gas saturation is not the same as dissolved gas represented by Rs.
records.limitations: No gas saturation is inferred from GOR alone.

records.definition: A water saturation below which water is treated as immobile under the specified displacement convention.
records.definition_ar: تشبع مائي يُعامل الماء دونه على أنه غير متحرك وفق اصطلاح الإزاحة المحدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Swi affects effective hydrocarbon pore volume and the endpoints of relative-permeability descriptions.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يؤثر Swi في الحجم المسامي الهيدروكربوني الفعال ونقاط نهاية منحنيات النفاذية النسبية.
records.usage: Used in petrophysics, initial saturation interpretation, and multiphase-flow endpoints.
records.notes: The word irreducible depends on wettability, displacement direction, and experimental convention.
records.limitations: It is not a universal constant for every scale or process.

records.definition: The oil saturation remaining after a specified displacement process, often treated as immobile under that process.
records.definition_ar: تشبع النفط الذي يبقى بعد عملية إزاحة محددة، ويُعامل غالبًا على أنه غير متحرك ضمن تلك العملية.
records.engineering_meaning: Sor is a process- and wettability-dependent endpoint used in recovery and relative-permeability interpretation.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يعتمد Sor على عملية الإزاحة والبلل، ويُستخدم كنقطة نهاية في تفسير الاسترداد والنفاذية النسبية.
records.usage: Used in displacement studies, recovery estimates, and relative-permeability models.
records.notes: Sor may differ for waterflooding, gas displacement, and miscible processes.
records.limitations: No single Sor is valid without process and saturation-history context.

records.definition: The effective permeability to a phase divided by the absolute permeability of the rock under a stated saturation condition.
records.definition_ar: نفاذية الطور الفعالة مقسومة على النفاذية المطلقة للصخر عند تشبع محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Relative permeability describes how the presence of competing phases reduces each phase’s ability to flow.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تصف النفاذية النسبية كيف تقلل الأطوار المتنافسة قدرة كل طور على الجريان.
records.dimensional_meaning: Effective phase permeability divided by absolute permeability.
records.formula: krα = kα / k
records.usage: Used in multiphase reservoir simulation, waterflood interpretation, and flow forecasting.
records.notes: Curves depend on saturation history, wettability, and experimental protocol.
records.limitations: A generic curve must not be treated as field data without validation.

records.definition: The pressure difference between two immiscible fluid phases in a porous medium, with sign convention stated.
records.definition_ar: فرق الضغط بين طورين غير ممتزجين داخل وسط مسامي، مع ضرورة تحديد اصطلاح الإشارة.
records.engineering_meaning: Capillary pressure links fluid distribution to pore structure, saturation, and wettability.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يربط الضغط الشعري توزيع الموائع ببنية المسام والتشبع والبلل.
records.formula: Pc = non-wetting-phase pressure - wetting-phase pressure under the stated convention
records.usage: Used in saturation-height functions, transition-zone analysis, and multiphase-flow models.
records.notes: Sign convention and drainage/imbibition path matter.
records.limitations: No capillary-pressure curve is inferred without rock and wettability data.

records.definition: Pressure representing the reservoir state at a defined location, time, and measurement or averaging convention.
records.definition_ar: ضغط يمثل حالة المكمن عند موقع وزمن واصطلاح قياس أو متوسط محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Reservoir pressure provides the reference for drawdown, material balance, saturation state, and well inflow.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يوفر ضغط المكمن مرجعًا للهبوط في الضغط وموازنة المادة وحالة التشبع والجريان الداخل للبئر.
records.formula: Drawdown is commonly represented as Pr - Pwf when the same pressure basis is used.
records.usage: Used in IPR, material balance, well testing, nodal analysis, and surveillance.
records.notes: Average, static, pressure-transient, and local reservoir pressures are not always interchangeable.
records.limitations: A measurement time and pressure basis are required for interpretation.
source: Earlougher, Advances in Well Test Analysis

records.definition: The temperature representing the reservoir fluid and rock state at a defined depth and reference condition.
records.definition_ar: درجة الحرارة التي تمثل حالة مائع وصخر المكمن عند عمق وشرط مرجعي محددين.
records.engineering_meaning: Reservoir temperature affects PVT properties, phase behavior, viscosity, and pressure-drop calculations.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تؤثر درجة حرارة المكمن في خصائص PVT وسلوك الأطوار واللزوجة وحسابات فقد الضغط.
records.usage: Used in PVT evaluation, fluid classification, thermal corrections, and well-performance models.
records.notes: Reference depth and geothermal assumptions should be stated.
records.limitations: A surface temperature must not be substituted for reservoir temperature without an explicit assumption.
source: Craft and Hawkins, Applied Petroleum Reservoir Engineering

records.definition: A volumetric flow rate on a stated fluid basis, often total oil plus water liquid rate in well-performance work.
records.definition_ar: معدل جريان حجمي على أساس مائع محدد، وغالبًا يعني معدل النفط والماء السائل الكلي في أداء الآبار.
records.engineering_meaning: The meaning of q depends on whether it is oil rate, liquid rate, gas rate, surface rate, or in-situ rate.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يعتمد معنى q على كونه معدل نفط أو سائل أو غاز أو معدلًا سطحيًا أو عند ظروف المكمن.
records.formula: q_liquid = qo + qw when both rates share the same surface basis
records.usage: Used in IPR, VLP, nodal analysis, choke, system, and production reporting.
records.notes: Always state fluid basis and conditions.
records.limitations: A bare q symbol is ambiguous without its basis.

records.definition: The volumetric production rate of oil on a stated surface or reservoir basis.
records.definition_ar: معدل إنتاج النفط الحجمي على أساس سطحي أو مكمني محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Oil rate is distinct from total liquid rate when water is present.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يختلف معدل النفط عن معدل السائل الكلي عند وجود ماء منتج.
records.usage: Used in production reporting, IPR, VLP, nodal analysis, and GOR calculations.
records.notes: STB/day is a stock-tank production basis.
records.limitations: No production value is inferred from a terminology question.

records.definition: The volumetric production or injection rate of gas on a stated standard or reservoir basis.
records.definition_ar: معدل إنتاج أو حقن الغاز الحجمي على أساس قياسي أو مكمني محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Gas rate is used in GOR, GLR, gas-lift, facility, and multiphase-flow calculations.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يُستخدم معدل الغاز في حسابات GOR وGLR والرفع بالغاز والمنشآت والجريان متعدد الأطوار.
records.usage: Used in production surveillance, gas-lift, choke, VLP, and facility calculations.
records.notes: The standard-condition definition must be stated.
records.limitations: A gas rate cannot be compared across sources without matching conditions.

records.definition: The volumetric production or injection rate of water on a stated basis.
records.definition_ar: معدل إنتاج أو حقن الماء الحجمي على أساس محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Water rate contributes to total liquid rate, water cut, WOR, and multiphase pressure loss.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يسهم معدل الماء في معدل السائل الكلي ونسبة الماء وWOR وفقد الضغط متعدد الأطوار.
records.formula: q_liquid = qo + qw
records.usage: Used in production reporting and well-performance calculations.
records.notes: Surface and reservoir water rates are not interchangeable without Bw.
records.limitations: No water rate is inferred without production data.

records.definition: Pressure referenced to the bottomhole or sandface location, with the static or flowing condition explicitly stated.
records.definition_ar: الضغط المنسوب إلى قاع البئر أو وجه التكوين مع تحديد ما إذا كانت الحالة ساكنة أو جارية.
records.engineering_meaning: BHP is a location-and-condition term; Pwf usually denotes flowing bottomhole pressure, but local conventions should be stated.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: BHP مصطلح يحدد الموقع والحالة؛ وغالبًا يدل Pwf على ضغط القاع أثناء الجريان، لكن يجب بيان اصطلاح المشروع.
records.dimensional_meaning: Absolute pressure at the bottomhole reference.
records.usage: Used in well testing, IPR, VLP, nodal analysis, and artificial-lift evaluation.
records.notes: Static BHP and flowing BHP are different conditions.
records.limitations: The exact depth, gauge position, and flow condition must be known.

records.definition: The pressure at the bottomhole or sandface while the well is flowing, under a stated reference convention.
records.definition_ar: الضغط عند قاع البئر أو وجه التكوين أثناء جريان البئر وفق اصطلاح مرجعي محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Pwf is a central variable in drawdown, IPR, nodal analysis, and the relationship between reservoir inflow and well outflow.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يُعد Pwf متغيرًا أساسيًا في الهبوط في الضغط وIPR والتحليل العقدي والعلاقة بين جريان المكمن والجريان الخارج من البئر.
records.dimensional_meaning: Absolute pressure at bottomhole during flow.
records.formula: For a simple liquid PI description, q = J (Pr - Pwf)
records.usage: Used in IPR, nodal analysis, VLP, system calculations, and well-performance reporting.
records.notes: Pwf is not a surface pressure and should not be substituted for Pwh or THP.
records.limitations: A Pwf result is model- and input-dependent; it is not automatically a measured pressure.

records.definition: Pressure measured or specified at the wellhead reference location.
records.definition_ar: الضغط المقاس أو المحدد عند الموقع المرجعي لرأس البئر.
records.engineering_meaning: Pwh is a surface boundary condition for tubing-flow and well-performance calculations and is not the same as Pwf.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يُعد Pwh شرطًا حدوديًا سطحيًا لحسابات جريان الأنبوب وأداء البئر، وليس هو Pwf.
records.usage: Used as tubing-flow boundary condition and in surface-system and choke evaluations.
records.notes: Gauge pressure and absolute pressure must not be mixed.
records.limitations: The exact pressure tap and whether the value is upstream or downstream of equipment matter.

records.definition: Pressure at the tubing head under a stated flowing or shut-in condition.
records.definition_ar: الضغط عند رأس أنبوب الإنتاج في حالة جريان أو إغلاق محددة.
records.engineering_meaning: THP is commonly used as the surface-pressure input for VLP and nodal calculations.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يُستخدم THP غالبًا كمدخل للضغط السطحي في حسابات VLP والتحليل العقدي.
records.usage: Used in VLP curves, nodal operating-point calculations, sensitivity sweeps, and system analysis.
records.notes: THP and casing-head pressure are different measurements.
records.limitations: Pressure location and gauge basis must be consistent with the selected model.

records.definition: A measure of a reservoir’s or well’s ability to deliver fluid, commonly expressed as rate per unit drawdown.
records.definition_ar: مقياس لقدرة المكمن أو البئر على توصيل المائع، ويُعبّر عنه عادةً بالمعدل لكل وحدة هبوط في الضغط.
records.engineering_meaning: For a simple linear inflow model, PI links rate to the difference between reservoir pressure and flowing bottomhole pressure.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: في نموذج الجريان الداخل الخطي، يربط PI المعدل بالفرق بين ضغط المكمن وضغط قاع البئر الجاري.
records.formula: PI = q / (Pr - Pwf) for a linear liquid inflow description
records.usage: Used in IPR, nodal analysis, well testing, and production performance characterization.
records.notes: SLB describes PI as volume delivered per psi of drawdown at the sandface.
records.limitations: PI may not remain constant for multiphase, nonlinear, transient, or stimulation-affected behavior.

records.definition: A relationship or curve connecting a well’s inflow rate to flowing bottomhole pressure under defined reservoir and fluid assumptions.
records.definition_ar: علاقة أو منحنى يربط معدل دخول المائع إلى البئر بضغط قاع البئر الجاري وفق افتراضات مكمن ومائع محددة.
records.engineering_meaning: IPR represents the reservoir-side deliverability; it is compared with VLP to identify an operating point.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يمثل IPR قابلية التوصيل من جهة المكمن، ويُقارن مع VLP لتحديد نقطة التشغيل.
records.dimensional_meaning: Functional relationship between rate and flowing pressure.
records.formula: Linear IPR: q = J(Pr - Pwf); other validated models may be nonlinear.
records.usage: Used in well-performance analysis, nodal analysis, artificial-lift screening, and sensitivity studies.
records.notes: The bot’s deterministic IPR engine remains the source of numerical results.
records.limitations: An IPR curve is model dependent and is not a field measurement by itself.

records.definition: A relationship between flow rate and the pressure required at the bottomhole to lift fluids through the wellbore under defined conditions.
records.definition_ar: علاقة بين معدل الجريان والضغط المطلوب عند القاع لرفع الموائع خلال البئر وفق شروط محددة.
records.engineering_meaning: VLP represents the wellbore and surface-side outflow requirement and is compared with IPR.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يمثل VLP متطلبات الجريان الخارج من جهة البئر والسطح، ويُقارن مع IPR.
records.dimensional_meaning: Functional relationship between required pressure and rate.
records.usage: Used in tubing design, nodal analysis, choke/system evaluation, and artificial-lift studies.
records.notes: The selected multiphase correlation, geometry, fluid properties, and boundary pressure matter.
records.limitations: A VLP result is a model calculation and not a measured pressure traverse unless calibrated.

records.definition: The pressure reduction between a reference reservoir pressure and a lower flowing pressure under a stated convention.
records.definition_ar: انخفاض الضغط بين ضغط مكمن مرجعي وضغط جريان أقل وفق اصطلاح محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Drawdown is the driving pressure difference for many inflow and well-test interpretations.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يمثل هبوط الضغط فرق الضغط الدافع في كثير من تفسيرات الجريان الداخل واختبارات الآبار.
records.formula: Δp = Pr - Pwf for the common flowing-well convention
records.usage: Used in PI, IPR, well testing, and reservoir deliverability analysis.
records.notes: Do not confuse drawdown with tubing or choke pressure loss.
records.limitations: The chosen reservoir-pressure reference and flowing pressure location must match.
source: Earlougher, Advances in Well Test Analysis

records.definition: The fraction of total produced liquid volume that is water, under a stated measurement basis.
records.definition_ar: النسبة من حجم السائل المنتج الكلي التي يمثلها الماء وفق أساس قياس محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Water cut indicates the water contribution to liquid production and affects mixture properties, VLP, and facilities.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: توضح نسبة الماء مساهمة الماء في إنتاج السوائل وتؤثر في خصائص المزيج وVLP والمنشآت.
records.dimensional_meaning: Water rate divided by total liquid rate.
records.formula: WC = qw / (qo + qw)
records.usage: Used in production surveillance, multiphase-flow models, VLP, nodal, and system calculations.
records.notes: The fraction form ranges from 0 to 1; the percent form ranges from 0 to 100.
records.limitations: Rates must share the same pressure and volume basis.

records.definition: The produced water volume divided by produced oil volume under a stated basis.
records.definition_ar: حجم الماء المنتج مقسومًا على حجم النفط المنتج وفق أساس محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: WOR is related to water cut but is not numerically identical; WOR increases without an upper bound as oil rate approaches zero.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يرتبط WOR بنسبة الماء لكنه ليس مساويًا لها عدديًا؛ وقد يرتفع بلا حد عندما يقترب معدل النفط من الصفر.
records.formula: WOR = qw / qo; WC = WOR / (1 + WOR) when bases match
records.usage: Used in water-production surveillance and multiphase well-performance calculations.
records.notes: WOR and WC require matching rate bases.
records.limitations: No ratio is calculated without rates.

records.definition: An artificial-lift method that injects gas into the wellbore to reduce the effective hydrostatic burden and assist fluid flow.
records.definition_ar: طريقة رفع اصطناعي يُحقن فيها الغاز داخل البئر لتقليل الحمل الهيدروستاتيكي الفعال ومساعدة جريان المائع.
records.engineering_meaning: Gas lift changes the wellbore mixture and pressure gradient; the response depends on injection depth, rate, pressure, geometry, and fluid properties.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يغير الرفع بالغاز مزيج البئر وتدرج الضغط، وتعتمد الاستجابة على عمق الحقن والمعدل والضغط والهندسة وخصائص الموائع.
records.dimensional_meaning: Artificial-lift process, not a single scalar property.
records.usage: Used in artificial-lift design, well-performance analysis, and the existing GasLiftEngine path.
records.notes: The knowledge layer explains gas lift; the released GasLiftEngine remains the numerical source of truth.
records.limitations: A definition does not determine an injection rate or operating design.

records.definition: Gas injected into a producing well to support artificial lift.
records.definition_ar: الغاز الذي يُحقن في البئر المنتج للمساعدة في الرفع الاصطناعي.
records.engineering_meaning: Lift gas becomes part of the wellbore mixture and can reduce mixture density while adding gas throughput and pressure requirements.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يصبح غاز الرفع جزءًا من مزيج البئر، وقد يقلل كثافة المزيج مع إضافة متطلبات للمعدل والضغط.
records.usage: Used in gas-lift calculations and injection-system descriptions.
records.notes: Injection rate and produced gas rate are different quantities.
records.limitations: No operating recommendation follows from the definition alone.

records.definition: The rate at which gas is injected into a well or reservoir under a stated standard or operating basis.
records.definition_ar: المعدل الذي يُحقن به الغاز في البئر أو المكمن وفق أساس قياس قياسي أو تشغيلي محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: In gas lift, injection rate affects mixture density, pressure gradient, compressor demand, and well response.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: في الرفع بالغاز، يؤثر معدل الحقن في كثافة المزيج وتدرج الضغط وحمل الضاغط واستجابة البئر.
records.usage: Used in the existing GasLiftEngine and in gas-lift system descriptions.
records.notes: An injection rate is not automatically an optimized rate.
records.limitations: A valid numerical response requires well geometry, pressure, temperature, and fluid assumptions.

records.definition: A restriction used to control or model fluid flow at the wellhead or in a production system.
records.definition_ar: تضييق يُستخدم للتحكم في جريان الموائع أو نمذجته عند رأس البئر أو داخل نظام الإنتاج.
records.engineering_meaning: A choke creates a pressure drop and its behavior depends on geometry, pressure ratio, fluid properties, and the selected correlation.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: ينشئ الخانق هبوطًا في الضغط، ويعتمد سلوكه على الهندسة ونسبة الضغط وخصائص المائع والعلاقة المختارة.
records.dimensional_meaning: Flow restriction with a characteristic opening.
records.usage: Used in the existing ChokeEngine and in surface-system evaluations.
records.notes: Gilbert 1954 is an empirical correlation in the released ChokeEngine V1.
records.limitations: A calculated choke rate is a model result, not a field measurement or operating instruction.
source: W. E. Gilbert (1954), Flowing and Gas-Lift Well Performance

records.definition: Pressure measured or specified on the upstream side of a restriction or equipment item.
records.definition_ar: الضغط المقاس أو المحدد في الجانب السابق للتضييق أو المعدة.
records.engineering_meaning: In choke work, upstream pressure is one boundary condition for determining pressure ratio and flow regime.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: في مسائل الخانق، يمثل ضغط المنبع أحد الشروط الحدية لتحديد نسبة الضغط ونظام الجريان.
records.usage: Used in the Gilbert choke calculation and pressure-drop descriptions.
records.notes: The measurement location must match the model definition.
records.limitations: Do not mix gauge and absolute pressure in a pressure-ratio calculation.
source: W. E. Gilbert (1954), Flowing and Gas-Lift Well Performance

records.definition: Pressure measured or specified on the downstream side of a restriction or equipment item.
records.definition_ar: الضغط المقاس أو المحدد في الجانب اللاحق للتضييق أو المعدة.
records.engineering_meaning: Downstream pressure combines with upstream pressure to define pressure ratio and the modeled choke-flow regime.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يتكامل ضغط المصب مع ضغط المنبع لتحديد نسبة الضغط ونظام جريان الخانق في النموذج.
records.usage: Used in choke calculations, system calculations, and pressure-drop reporting.
records.notes: A downstream pressure can be separator, flowline, or facility pressure depending on the setup.
records.limitations: The exact pressure location and absolute/gauge basis must be stated.
source: W. E. Gilbert (1954), Flowing and Gas-Lift Well Performance

records.definition: A flow condition in which the restriction controls the response and downstream-pressure changes have limited influence within the model’s critical-flow regime.
records.definition_ar: حالة جريان يتحكم فيها التضييق في الاستجابة ويكون تأثير تغير ضغط المصب محدودًا ضمن نظام الجريان الحرج للنموذج.
records.engineering_meaning: Critical flow is a model classification and must be interpreted together with the selected choke correlation and its validity limits.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: الجريان الحرج تصنيف نمذجة، ويجب تفسيره مع علاقة الخانق المختارة وحدود صلاحيتها.
records.usage: Used to describe the regime returned by the existing ChokeEngine.
records.notes: The label does not by itself certify field operability.
records.limitations: Regime classification is correlation and input dependent.
source: W. E. Gilbert (1954), Flowing and Gas-Lift Well Performance

records.definition: A flow condition in which downstream pressure can materially influence the flow response through the restriction.
records.definition_ar: حالة جريان يمكن أن يؤثر فيها ضغط المصب بصورة ملموسة في الاستجابة عبر التضييق.
records.engineering_meaning: Subcritical flow indicates stronger coupling between upstream and downstream conditions than critical flow within the selected model.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يشير الجريان دون الحرج إلى ترابط أقوى بين ظروف المنبع والمصب مقارنة بالجريان الحرج داخل النموذج المختار.
records.usage: Used to interpret the regime returned by a choke or restriction model.
records.notes: The exact transition criterion depends on the correlation or mechanistic model.
records.limitations: The label alone is not an equipment design result.
source: W. E. Gilbert (1954), Flowing and Gas-Lift Well Performance

records.definition: A classification of the prevailing flow behavior, such as critical or subcritical flow in a choke model.
records.definition_ar: تصنيف لسلوك الجريان السائد، مثل الجريان الحرج أو دون الحرج في نموذج الخانق.
records.engineering_meaning: The regime label summarizes model behavior; it does not replace pressure, rate, fluid, and geometry data.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تلخص تسمية النظام سلوك النموذج، لكنها لا تغني عن بيانات الضغط والمعدل والمائع والهندسة.
records.usage: Used in readable engineering reports and model interpretation.
records.notes: Different models may use different regime definitions.
records.limitations: Do not infer field safety or operating instructions from the label alone.
source: W. E. Gilbert (1954), Flowing and Gas-Lift Well Performance

records.definition: The mass of oil per unit volume at a stated pressure and temperature condition.
records.definition_ar: كتلة النفط لكل وحدة حجم عند ضغط ودرجة حرارة محددين.
records.engineering_meaning: Oil density affects hydrostatic pressure, mixture density, gravity segregation, and material-balance conversions.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تؤثر كثافة النفط في الضغط الهيدروستاتيكي وكثافة المزيج والفصل بالجاذبية والتحويلات الحجمية.
records.formula: Density = mass / volume; reservoir density is state dependent.

formula_variables.volume: oil volume at the stated condition

records.usage: Used in pressure-gradient, hydrostatic, PVT, and multiphase-flow calculations.
records.notes: Surface density and reservoir-condition density are different quantities.
records.limitations: A numerical value requires fluid composition and a defined pressure-temperature state.
source: Craft and Hawkins, Applied Petroleum Reservoir Engineering

records.definition: The mass of gas per unit volume at a stated pressure and temperature condition.
records.definition_ar: كتلة الغاز لكل وحدة حجم عند ضغط ودرجة حرارة محددين.
records.engineering_meaning: Gas density affects pressure gradient, buoyancy, flow regime, and gas-volume conversions.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تؤثر كثافة الغاز في تدرج الضغط والطفو ونظام الجريان وتحويلات حجم الغاز.
records.formula: For a real gas, density is related to pressure, temperature, molecular weight, and Z-factor.
records.usage: Used in gas-flow, VLP, gas-lift, and pressure-gradient calculations.
records.notes: Standard-condition density and reservoir-condition density must not be mixed.
records.limitations: A numerical value requires gas composition or gravity and a defined state.
source: Lee, Gonzalez, and Eakin (1966) property framework

records.definition: The mass of water per unit volume at a stated pressure, temperature, and salinity condition.
records.definition_ar: كتلة الماء لكل وحدة حجم عند ضغط ودرجة حرارة وملوحة محددة.
records.engineering_meaning: Water density contributes to hydrostatic pressure, mixture density, and water-flow calculations.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تسهم كثافة الماء في الضغط الهيدروستاتيكي وكثافة المزيج وحسابات جريان الماء.
records.usage: Used in water-column, multiphase-flow, and pressure-gradient calculations.
records.notes: Salinity and temperature may materially affect water density.
records.limitations: No numerical density is inferred without water-state information.
source: Craft and Hawkins, Applied Petroleum Reservoir Engineering

records.definition: The gas saturation remaining after a specified displacement process, often treated as immobile for that process.
records.definition_ar: تشبع الغاز الذي يبقى بعد عملية إزاحة محددة، ويُعامل غالبًا على أنه غير متحرك في تلك العملية.
records.engineering_meaning: Sgr is a saturation endpoint that affects gas relative permeability and recoverable gas under a specified history.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: يُعد Sgr نقطة نهاية تشبع تؤثر في النفاذية النسبية للغاز والغاز القابل للاستخراج وفق تاريخ إزاحة محدد.
records.usage: Used in gas-displacement studies and relative-permeability endpoint definitions.
records.notes: Residual saturation depends on wettability, displacement direction, and saturation history.
records.limitations: It is not a universal constant for all rock-fluid systems.

records.definition: The fractional change in bulk or pore volume of a rock per unit pressure change under a stated convention.
records.definition_ar: التغير النسبي في الحجم الكلي أو المسامي للصخر لكل وحدة تغير في الضغط وفق اصطلاح محدد.
records.engineering_meaning: Rock compressibility contributes to reservoir storage and pressure response, especially in undersaturated or weakly compressible systems.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تسهم انضغاطية الصخر في تخزين المكمن واستجابة الضغط، خصوصًا في الأنظمة قليلة الانضغاطية.
records.formula: cr = fractional rock-volume change per pressure change under the stated definition

formula_variables.rock-volume change: change in bulk or pore volume

records.usage: Used in material balance, reservoir storage, and pressure-transient interpretation.
records.notes: Bulk-rock and pore-volume compressibility are not always identical.
records.limitations: Measurement scale, stress path, and pressure range matter.

records.definition: The hydrocarbon, water, or mixed fluid system occupying reservoir pore space at reservoir conditions.
records.definition_ar: نظام الموائع الهيدروكربونية أو المائية أو المختلطة الذي يشغل مسام المكمن عند ظروف المكمن.
records.engineering_meaning: Reservoir-fluid identity and state control PVT properties, phase behavior, mobility, and production response.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: تتحكم هوية مائع المكمن وحالته في خصائص PVT وسلوك الأطوار والحركة واستجابة الإنتاج.
records.dimensional_meaning: A fluid-system concept, not a scalar unit.
records.usage: Used to select PVT descriptions, phase behavior, and well-performance assumptions.
records.notes: A reservoir-fluid label is not a complete composition or laboratory PVT report.
records.limitations: Fluid classification requires appropriate data and may be uncertain without composition and PVT measurements.

records.definition: A ratio that converts a fluid volume between standard or surface conditions and reservoir conditions, with the phase specified.
records.definition_ar: نسبة تحول حجم المائع بين الظروف القياسية أو السطحية وظروف المكمن، مع تحديد الطور المقصود.
records.engineering_meaning: The phase-specific forms Bo, Bg, and Bw are not interchangeable and use different volume bases.
records.engineering_meaning_ar: الأشكال الخاصة بالأطوار Bo وBg وBw ليست متبادلة، ولكل منها أساس حجمي مختلف.
records.dimensional_meaning: Reservoir-condition volume divided by reference-condition volume.
records.usage: Used in surface-to-reservoir volume conversion and material-balance calculations.
records.notes: Always name the phase and state the standard-condition basis.
records.limitations: A generic FVF label is insufficient for a numerical value.
source: SLB Energy Glossary — oil formation volume factor: https://glossary.slb.com/terms/o/oil_formation_volume_factor
Craft and Hawkins, Applied Petroleum Reservoir Engineering
